**BiliMind Desktop** is a study app on your computer: courses, written lessons, checks of what stuck, notes, whiteboards and a daily plan, with your own AI key and no account.

Tested on Linux. The Windows and macOS builds have not been run yet, and none of the builds is code-signed.

Full list: [changelog](https://github.com/bilimind/desktop/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
